evidenceQuote: Бавен пешеходец на пътеката · Ниво 1 — Пълна помощ · резултат — 0 наказателни точки · ИЗДЪРЖАН · +150 XP — the +150 paid on DESKTOP, while the same lesson's mobile-right debrief pays +100 (cropped: _crop-scratch xp-sc-crossing-slow-crosser__mobile-right.png)
why: OVERTURNS STILL. The row reads «The same correct drive earns +150 XP on mobile and +100 XP on PC». Both numbers are real for this lesson — mobile-right 23:10:50 pays +150, pc-right 23:15:29 pays +100 — but the inference is false. The split is not platform-dependent, so the row cannot be fixed — its premise is false. In sc-crossing-slow-crosser it INVERTS: pc-right pays +150 and mobile-right +100, both cropped and read. What predicts every wave-C lesson that has two passing legs is RUN ORDER, off the frames' own mtimes — sc-vp-telltale mobile 23:10:50 (+150) then pc 23:15:29 (+100); sc-pk-smooth-stop mobile 02:19:25 (+150) then pc 02:21:06 (+100); sc-ac-ice mobile 01:03:12 (+150) then pc 01:06:41 (+100); sc-crossing-slow-crosser pc 00:02:55 (+150) then mobile 00:06:00 (+100). Four for four, including the inversion. The arithmetic is single-valued: platform/src/modules/gamification/xp.ts awards 40 completed + 60 passed + XP_SIM_FIRST_PASS_BONUS = 50 gated on `event.passed && event.firstPass === true` + 10×cleanDrives, so 150 = 40+60+50 and 100 = 40+60 differ in exactly one term — the ONE-TIME first-ever-pass milestone. lessons/progression.ts already carries this refutation in its header with the sweep161 mtimes, and __tests__/progression-sweep161-xp.test.ts holds the enumeration plus the counter-proof that no cleanDrives value can manufacture 150 without the milestone. A repeat pass paid less; a platform did not. The prior judge reached this conclusion after writing STILL here and asked in new-findings.jsonl for the line to be overridden; that request was never written into the channel the poster reads, so this line is it.

evidenceQuote: 23 км/ч · D · 90 · РЕЖИМ Нормален ≤100 · знакът важи — the cockpit at t = 187 s of a 210 s drive, on an empty carriageway with no lead car anywhere in the windscreen
why: THE MECHANISM IS FALSE: BOTH NUMBERS ARE THE INSTRUMENT'S OWN CONTROL LAW, NOT THE PRODUCT'S TRAFFIC. tools/mobile/lesson-audit.mjs lines 3489-3545 define the RIGHT-mode careful driver as DRIVE_BUDGET_MS 210_000, CRUISE_KMH 12, ROLL_MS 4000, ROLL_DISTANCE_M 15, STOP_MS 3000, cycled — creep at most 15 m or 4 s, then come to REST for 3 s, repeat, scenario-independent by construction. (a) «STOPS 26 TIMES BEHIND A LEAD CAR THAT BARELY MOVES»: 210 s divided by (4000+3000 ms) is 30 cycles, so 26 on mobile and 28 on pc are the harness's own rest phases counted, and the file says so in as many words — «never travel further than this without coming to rest and looking». The proof re-drive prints the identical sawtooth on this exact lesson (mobile 9·3·11·29·16·0·17·13·0·11·17·0·12·0·1·15·0·0·0…, pc 13·8·4·0·0·11·0·13·0·0·12…), and this frame shows the car alone on an empty road at the 187th second, with no lead vehicle to be stopped behind. (b) «NEVER GETS ABOVE 20 КМ/Ч»: the same file predicts its own ceiling — «Peak speed is therefore roughly (CRUISE − 3) + 20», about 29, from a measured 2.0-4.2 s CDP actuation latency. The proof run.log peaks at 29 км/ч on mobile and 27 on pc, and the frame cited here reads 23, so even the literal number in the finding is contradicted on the photograph. The row's conclusion — «on a road signed 90 the car never behaves like a car in traffic» — describes the audit harness's careful-driver script, which is the same script on all 195 lessons; nothing about SC_OV_ABORT is on trial in it. This is the class the round-2 commit message names (27 open findings, 17 critical, resting on «the correct drive crawls at 0-14 км/ч»), and the earlier #751 marked it STILL from a wave-c frame without ever reaching the control law. NOT REFUTED HERE, AND STILL OPEN ELSEWHERE: whether the PRODUCT graded that crawl correctly — a crawl that is nonetheless awarded stars or credit is a rubric defect and belongs to its own row.

evidenceQuote: DRIVE: right · top 21 км/ч · 6 full stops · 1 lawful wait honoured (10s) · 1 pause layer drained · refused 1 standstill brake press (would have selected R)
why: THE STATED MECHANISM IS FALSE: NO DRIVE IN THIS CORPUS EVER TOUCHES A TOUCH BRAKE. A keyboard census of tools/mobile/lesson-audit.mjs returns KeyW, KeyS, KeyA/KeyD and Escape and NOTHING else — there is no page.touchscreen, no tap(), no dispatchTouchEvent and no pointerdown anywhere in the harness, on either leg. The pedal helper is literally `await page.keyboard[on ? "down" : "up"]("KeyS").catch(() => {})` (lesson-audit.mjs:1174). The pad in TouchControls.tsx is therefore never pressed, never released and never read on any of the 195 proof drives, so it cannot have dropped a press that never happened. THE SECOND ROUTE TO THIS FILE IS CLOSED TOO: TouchInputSource.mergeInto overwrites an axis only when that axis is ACTIVE — `if (this.brakeActive) out.brake = this.brakeValue` (modules/sim/engine/touch.ts:383-387) — and brakeActive is false with no finger down, so the touch source cannot erase a keyboard brake either. THE THIRD IS CLOSED BY THE FRAMES: the one global thing this file listens for is keydown (TouchControls.tsx:1974-1986, hide the pad on keyboard takeover), and the dock is painted on EVERY beat of every mobile proof drive after minutes of key driving (control census, proof/frames/sc-park-judge__mobile-right/run.log:1210-1217, all eight stations hud=touch-controls), so the takeover never fires on this profile. THE SYMPTOM IS REAL AND IS NOT CLOSED — IT IS MISFILED. On this lesson the post-repair mobile drive still logs «DRIVE: right · top 21 км/ч · 6 full stops · 1 lawful wait honoured (10s) · 1 pause layer drained · refused 1 standstill brake press (would have selected R)» — the guard did not fire at all in this run, which settles nothing either way; corpus-wide the guard fires 196× across 78 of 97 mobile proof drives against 2× across 2 of 98 pc drives. But the two things that separate the legs are not the pad: the mobile leg's mean scan costs 662 ms against pc's 193 ms (3.4×), so the guard's two-sample `p.kmh > prevKmh + 2` test spans a far longer gap; and the harness sets its own belief flag AFTER a swallowed rejection (`.catch(() => {}); holdS = on;`, lesson-audit.mjs:1174-1175), so a keydown the harness failed to SEND is indistinguishable from one the sim failed to RECEIVE. The harness's own margin names a third candidate at lesson-audit.mjs:3885-3893 — «a key sent while a modal owns the focus can simply never reach the sim's input handler … the keydown had gone to a teach card». RE-FILE against the keyboard/focus path with a real key-event assertion. TouchControls.tsx is the wrong suspect and 19 criticals have been parked on it.
